APPETISERS.name: POR PIA (Vegetable Spring Rolls)
APPETISERS.description: Crispy spring rolls filled with mixed vegetables and rice vermicelli. Served with sweet chilli sauce.

APPETISERS.name: VEGETABLE SATAY ! !
APPETISERS.description: Grilled skewers of mushroom, carrot, onion, red & green pepper, cherry tomatoes and tofu. Served with peanut sauce and cucumber relish.

APPETISERS.name: STEAMED BLACK MUSSELS
APPETISERS.description: Large black mussels steamed with lemongrass, basil, galangal, kaempfer root and fresh chilli.

APPETISERS.name: VEGETABLE TEMPURA !
APPETISERS.description: Mixed vegetables coated in light, crispy tempura batter. Deep fried and served with sweet chilli sauce.

APPETISERS.name: SOMTUM (Green Papaya and Carrot Salad)
APPETISERS.description: Fresh shredded green papaya and carrots with green beans, cherry tomatoes and peanuts, tossed in a spicy dressing made from fresh lime, garlic and tamarind. ***Also makes a great side dish or main course***

APPETISERS.name: GAI GEOW
APPETISERS.description: Deep fried marinated strips of chicken breast, coated in Asian breadcrumbs. Served with sweet chilli sauce.

APPETISERS.name: GAI SATAY
APPETISERS.description: Marinated chicken on a bamboo skewer. Grilled and served with homemade roasted peanut sauce and cucumber relish.

APPETISERS.name: POR PIA PED (Duck Spring Rolls)
APPETISERS.description: Crispy spring rolls filled with shredded duck, carrot, and leek. Served with homemade hoisin sauce.

APPETISERS.name: KANOM JEEP
APPETISERS.description: Minced pork, water chestnut, onion, spring onion and sesame oil. Wrapped in wanton skin, then steamed and served with garlic oil and sweet soya sauce.

APPETISERS.name: THAI BARN SQUID
APPETISERS.description: Tender squid lightly coated in a crisp batter, deep fried and sprinkled with salt. Garnished with spring onion and fresh chilli. Served with sweet chilli sauce.

APPETISERS.name: PRAWN TEMPURA
APPETISERS.description: Deep-fried, marinated king prawns in a light crispy batter. Served with sweet chilli sauce.

APPETISERS.name: PED RON
APPETISERS.description: A special oriental appetiser. Aromatic duck served with warm pancakes in a bamboo basket, shredded cucumber, carrot, leek and hoisin sauce.

APPETISERS.name: THAI BARN PLATTER
APPETISERS.description: A selection of vegetable spring rolls, chicken satay, kanom jeep and prawn tempura.

THAI SOUPS.name: TOM YUM NAM KORN
THAI SOUPS.description: All-time favourite hot and spicy soup with lemongrass, kaffir lime leaves, galangal, fresh chilli, mushroom, cherry tomatoes, light cream and a touch of lime juice. Choice of Chicken £8.95, King Prawn £9.35 or Mushroom £7.95 !

THAI SOUPS.name: TOM KHAA
THAI SOUPS.description: A delightful Thai coconut soup made with lemongrass, kaffir lime leaves, galangal, red onion and cherry tomatoes. Please let us know if you would like it spicy. Choice of Chicken £8.95, King Prawn £9.35 or Mushroom £7.95 !

THAI SOUPS.name: POH TEAK
THAI SOUPS.description: A spicy clear soup of mixed seafood with lemongrass, galangal, mushrooms, red onion, kaempfer root, holy basil, kaffir leaves and fresh chilli.

THAI BARN SPECIALTIES.name: DUCK WITH HONEY AND CHILLI SAUCE !
THAI BARN SPECIALTIES.description: Deep fried crispy roast duck with a mild honey and red chilli sauce. Garnished with red pepper and coriander and served on a sizzling dish.

THAI BARN SPECIALTIES.name: TAMARIND DUCK
THAI BARN SPECIALTIES.description: Roasted aromatic duck breast served on a bed of cooked Chinese leaf. Dressed with tamarind sauce, crispy shallots, coriander and red pepper.

THAI BARN SPECIALTIES.name: SIZZLING SEAFOOD
THAI BARN SPECIALTIES.description: Stir-fried mixed seafood (king prawns, squid and mussels) with bell pepper and spring onions. Served in a garlic and pepper sauce and garnished with red pepper and coriander.

THAI BARN SPECIALTIES.name: WEEPING TIGER
THAI BARN SPECIALTIES.description: Grilled marinated sirloin steak served sizzling on a bed of grilled onion and bell pepper, with a spicy ground chilli and tamarind sauce on the side. Please let us know how you like your steak cooked.

THAI BARN SPECIALTIES.name: PAD CHA
THAI BARN SPECIALTIES.description: Spicy stir-fried sea bass dusted in flour OR mixed seafood (king prawns, squid and mussels) OR king prawns with fresh lemongrass, kaempfer root, sweet basil, galangal, garlic, red chilli, pepper corns, green beans and bell pepper. Can be made mild on request. Sea bass £22.95 Mixed Seafood or King Prawns £23.95

THAI BARN SPECIALTIES.name: LAMB SHANK MASSAMAN
THAI BARN SPECIALTIES.description: Chef’s Special A truly luxurious dish. Lamb shank slowly cooked in a massaman sauce until it becomes meltingly tender. The warm spices are blended with coconut milk, potatoes and broccoli. Garnished with crispy shallots, coriander and red pepper.

STIR FRIES.name: STIR-FRIED BROCCOLI
STIR FRIES.description: Stir-fried broccoli with garlic, carrot and ginger.

STIR FRIES.name: PAD PAK RUAM
STIR FRIES.description: Stir-fried mixed vegetables in garlic and oyster sauce. Can be made spicy on request.

STIR FRIES.name: MIXED MUSHROOMS
STIR FRIES.description: Black mushrooms, button mushrooms, and Chinese fungus stir fried in oyster sauce with garlic and spring onion.

STIR FRIES.name: STIR-FRIED AUBERGINE
STIR FRIES.description: Stir-fried aubergine with garlic, sweet basil and fresh red chilli.

STIR FRIES.name: PAD NAMMAN HOI
STIR FRIES.description: Stir fried with garlic, mushrooms, onion, spring onion, carrot, bell pepper and broccoli.

STIR FRIES.name: PAD KING
STIR FRIES.description: Stir fried with fresh ginger, garlic, mushroom, Chinese fungus, spring onion, carrot and bell pepper.

STIR FRIES.name: TOD GRATIAM PRIK THAI
STIR FRIES.description: Stir fried with fresh garlic, spring onion, onion and black pepper. Sprinkled with crispy garlic and coriander then served on a bed of lettuce.

STIR FRIES.name: PAD MED MAMUANG HIMMAPARN
STIR FRIES.description: Stir fried with cashew nuts, carrot, bell peppers, mushroom, garlic, spring onion, onion and roasted chilli.

STIR FRIES.name: PAD PED
STIR FRIES.description: Stir fried with red curry paste, bamboo shoots, green beans, sweet basil and bell pepper.

STIR FRIES.name: PAD GRAPAO
STIR FRIES.description: Stir fried with garlic, fresh chilli, basil, onion, bell pepper and green beans. Can be made mild on request.

STIR FRIES.name: PREOW WAAN (Sweet & Sour) !
STIR FRIES.description: Sautéed with pineapple, onion, cucumber, bell pepper, Chinese fungus, carrot, tomato and spring onion in a sweet & sour sauce.

THAI CURRIES.name: MASSAMAN CURRY (Chef’s Choice)
THAI CURRIES.description: A Massaman curry blend with dry spices such as cumin and star anise cooked with coconut milk, potatoes, onion, carrots and peanuts. Garnished with crispy shallots. Choice of slow cooked chicken thigh £14.95 or beef £16.95. King Prawn £16.95 or Mixed Seafood £17.95

THAI CURRIES.name: CHOO CHEE CURRY
THAI CURRIES.description: Rich and aromatic Thai Choo Chee curry paste with coconut milk, cherry tomatoes, pineapple, bell pepper, sweet basil and kaempfer root. Topped with coriander.

THAI CURRIES.name: GANG KIEW WAAN (Green Curry)
THAI CURRIES.description: The famous fragrant Thai green curry cooked in coconut milk with aubergine, bamboo shoots, green beans, bell pepper and basil.

THAI CURRIES.name: GANG PED (Red Curry)
THAI CURRIES.description: Thai red curry cooked in coconut milk with aubergine, green beans, bamboo shoots, bell pepper and basil.

THAI CURRIES.name: PANANG CURRY
THAI CURRIES.description: An aromatic Panang curry cooked with coconut milk, bell pepper, green beans, kaempfer root and basil. Finished with coconut cream and kaffir leaves.

THAI CURRIES.name: GANG GAREE (Yellow Curry)
THAI CURRIES.description: Mild yellow curry cooked in coconut milk with potatoes and onion. Garnished with crispy shallots and bell pepper.

THAI CURRIES.name: GANG PA (Jungle Curry)
THAI CURRIES.description: A spicy Thai curry that does not contain coconut milk. Made with bamboo shoots, bell pepper, green beans, cauliflower, carrots, kaempfer root, basil and fresh peppercorn.

NOODLES & RICE.name: SPICY RICE NOODLES !
NOODLES & RICE.description: Spicy stir-fried rice noodles with egg, oyster sauce, kaempfer root, peppercorn, garlic, green beans, bell pepper, onion and basil. With king prawn £16.95, chicken £14.95, beef £16.45, mixed seafood £16.95, tofu or mixed vegetables £13.95

NOODLES & RICE.name: URBAN NOODLES !
NOODLES & RICE.description: Stir-fried rice noodles with light soya sauce, egg, carrots, sweet heart cabbage, garlic and oyster sauce. Can be made with soya sauce instead for a vegetarian option. With king prawn £16.95, chicken £14.95, tofu or mixed vegetables £13.95

NOODLES & RICE.name: PAD THAI !
NOODLES & RICE.description: Stir-fried rice noodles with tamarind sauce, egg, beansprouts, carrot and spring onion. Served with crushed peanuts and a lemon wedge. If you would like it spicy, ask for some ground chilli. With king prawn £16.95, chicken £14.95, tofu or mixed vegetables £13.95 !

NOODLES & RICE.name: PLAIN NOODLES! !
NOODLES & RICE.description: Stir-fried rice noodles with soya sauce, beansprouts, carrots and spring onion.

NOODLES & RICE.name: 44 KAO PAD SABPAROD (Pineapple Fried Rice)
NOODLES & RICE.description: Egg fried rice with chicken, king prawns, pineapple, sultanas, onion, carrot, bell pepper, curry powder and cashew nuts. Served inside a hollowed out pineapple when eaten in house. (Chef’s Choice)

NOODLES & RICE.name: SPECIAL FRIED RICE!
NOODLES & RICE.description: Egg fried rice with carrot, onion, bell pepper and tomatoes. With chicken £13.95, beef £14.45, king prawn £14.95 or mixed vegetables £12.95

SET MENUS.name: SET MENU A
SET MENUS.description: APPETISER A mixed platter of Spring Rolls, Chicken Satay and Prawn Tempura. MAIN COURSE 35. Green Curry - Beef 29. Pad Med Mamuang Himmaparn - Chicken 23. Pad Pak Ruam

SET MENUS.name: SET MENU B
SET MENUS.description: APPETISER 12. Ped Ron- aromatic duck served with warm pancakes in a bamboo basket, shredded cucumber, carrot, leek and hoisin sauce. MAIN COURSE 31. Pad Grapao - King Prawn 33. Massaman Curry- Beef 22. Stir-fried Broccoli

SET MENUS.name: VEGETARIAN SET MENU
SET MENUS.description: APPETISER V13. A mixed platter of Vegetable Spring Rolls, Vegetable Satay and Vegetable Tempura MAIN COURSE V34. Choo Chee Curry - Tofu V32. Sweet & Sour - Mixed Vegetables V25. Stir-fried Aubergine
